observations.body: As they descend, Jesus tells the disciples not to report the vision until the Son of Man rises from the dead.

observations.body: Their Elijah question leads Jesus to speak of Elijah’s coming, rejection, and the Son of Man’s suffering; they understand him to mean John the Baptizer.

payload.posture: Read Matthew 17:9–13 as silence and elijah on the descent evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The disciples’ understanding is reported, but the passage does not erase John’s own denial language elsewhere.
